item.description:
Location: Qatar
Description:

A 2nd Officer position is available on a scientific research vessel operating in Qatar. Applicants must possess at least 5 years of seagoing experience as a deck officer, with specific experience in scientific research vessel operations, passage planning, navigation, chat and publication management, voyage documentation, and safety drills. Required qualifications include a valid Certificate of Competency as Officer in Charge of a Navigational Watch, STCW basic safety training, medical fitness certificate, ECDIS and GMDSS certificates, and a valid flag state endorsement. Salary offered is QR6,000 – QR7,000 per month, with free work permit, food, accommodation, and transport provided in Qatar.



Apply to this job
